title: GCD / UMCP: The First Seam-Chain Casepack: A Worked Case Showing Composed Continuity Across Multiple Welded Seams
main_question: When do individually admissible local welds compose into one admissible seam-chain rather than merely a sequence of local successes?
open_burdens: Source-stated ('What This Enables Next'): a small domain closure with welded transitions (declaring its domain adapter before applying local weld and chain accounting), a publication-infrastructure casepack using receipt chains, a repository implementation of seam-chain validation, and a failure taxonomy for chain composition. The paper enables these burdens but does not absorb them; no external-domain chain closure is claimed to have occurred.
